items.name: Mia R.
items.tagline: Keeper of the best hallway dance moves
items.story: Mia has one rule: nobody walks the hallway without at least one spin. She taught her whole dance line a signature move, and it now shows up at every OttoTHON rehearsal.

items.name: Jonah T.
items.story: Jonah keeps a running list of song requests from everyone on his floor. His favorite moment of the year is when the whole room sings the same chorus at once.

items.name: Priya S.
items.story: Priya greets every volunteer with a sticker and a high five, in that order. She says the stickers are for good luck, and the high fives are for energy.

items.name: Eli W.
items.tagline: Inventor of the world’s longest handshake
items.story: Eli’s handshake has eleven steps and a dramatic finish. Dancers line up to learn it, and he grades them on form.

items.name: Sofia M.
items.story: Sofia draws a daisy on every card, bandage box, and whiteboard she finds. The first one she drew for OttoTHON is now the team’s favorite sticker.

items.name: Amari B.
items.story: Amari wears a blue cape on Wednesdays and calls it official uniform. He has promised to teach the E-Board his flying pose before the finale.

items.name: Noah K.
items.story: Noah quizzes volunteers on dinosaur facts and keeps score on a napkin. The current record holder has eight points, and he is not impressed.

items.name: Lucy H.
items.story: Lucy saves her seat at the front before the doors open. She says the best part is watching the dance floor fill up all at once.
